notes: The bimanual/ALOHA-origin BC method. Chunks actions, single fwd pass + temporal ensembling. Best first implementation to learn fundamentals. No language.
Denoising diffusion over action trajectories. Strong on contact-rich tasks. Single-task, no language conditioning.
Discretizes actions into a learned codebook, GPT predicts codes. Two-phase training. Good for multimodal behavior.

Purpose-built for SO-100/101 on consumer HW. Pretrained on community LeRobot data. Paper reports matching/beating ACT & pi0 on SO-100/101 (author-reported). Freeze SigLIP+SmolLM2, tune action expert. Strong starting VLA.
Physical Intelligence flagship. Flow-matching (pi0) or autoregressive FAST tokens. Strong generalist, heavier compute.
NVIDIA. Best-documented SO-101 fine-tune path, dual-camera configs, bimanual eval done. LoRA for 16GB. Lots of tutorials.
Recent strong performer (author-reported AgiBot World Challenge win, IROS'25; SOTA on several sim+real benchmarks, ICLR'26 submission). Soft prompts for cross-embodiment. Newest frontier candidate.
Zero architectural change: VLM emits action numbers as text. Paper reports improvement over SmolVLA on SO-100 (author-reported). Conceptually clean for learning.
7B, trained on 970k OXE episodes. Beats the 55B RT-2-X by 16.5% abs success with 7x fewer params — the headline evidence that BIGGER != BETTER in VLAs. Fixed-base tabletop; no native mobile base.
Google's 55B flagship. Beaten by the 7B OpenVLA. Weights closed. Listed as the size ceiling reference — proof that scale alone plateaus for manipulation.

Largest DIFFUSION bimanual foundation model. Pretrained on 46 datasets / 1M+ episodes + 6k ALOHA. Unified action space EXPLICITLY supports wheeled locomotion — relevant to your mobile base. Strong few-shot (1-5 demos).

THE mobile-manipulation model: controls a mobile manipulator (base+arm) to clean unseen kitchens/bedrooms, 10-15 min multi-stage tasks. Co-trains web+multi-robot+semantic data. Best architectural fit for base+arm whole-body. Weights closed but openpi lets you train the arch.

Unified latent learning for whole-body loco-manipulation; learns from action-free video to fight data scarcity. Research-grade, humanoid-focused, but the loco+manip unification is conceptually what a mobile base needs.

arch_type: Self-supervised joint-embedding video world model + MPC planning
notes: JEPA line (LeCun). Pretrained on >1M hrs internet video; action-conditioned head trained on ~62 hrs unlabeled Droid. Plans via Cross-Entropy-Method MPC minimizing L1 in latent space to a GOAL IMAGE. Zero-shot on unseen Franka arms, monocular uncalibrated cam: reach ~100%, grasp/manip ~60-80% (author-reported). ~16s/action (slow, planning-based). No language, not reactive. arXiv:2506.09985.

arch_type: World model on frozen DINO features + planning
notes: DINO-WM (2025; authors/venue not confirmed in-session - verify). World model built on pretrained DINO visual features; zero-shot planning without action labels. Same 'predict-then-plan' family as V-JEPA 2; conceptual reference for the JEPA/world-model-planning approach.
